items.title: Court Closure on September 29, 2026 — U.S. District Court, District of Maine — News & Announcements
items.content_text:
Wednesday, September 23, 2026
The Clerk’s Office for the U.S. District Court for the District of Maine will be closed on September 29, 2026, for a full-day staff training.
Designated staff will be available to address urgent matters and will monitor the Joint ECF Inbox throughout the day.
items.content_html:
Wednesday, September 23, 2026

The Clerk’s Office for the U.S. District Court for the District of Maine will be closed on September 29, 2026, for a full-day staff training. 

Designated staff will be available to address urgent matters and will monitor the Joint ECF Inbox throughout the day.

items.title: Softwood Lumber Board Assessment Rate Clarification and Changes to Membership — Federal Register — Documents Matching 'Maine'
items.content_text: This final rule implements changes to the Softwood Lumber Research, Promotion, Consumer Education and Industry Information Order (Order). The changes include clarifying the assessment rate for softwood lumber imported into the United States and revising the membership of the Softwood Lumber Board (Board or SLB).

items.title: Press Release: September 18, 2026 Naturalization Ceremony — U.S. District Court, District of Maine — News & Announcements
items.content_text:
Friday, September 18, 2026
UNITED STATES DISTRICT COURT
Description automatically generated
DISTRICT OF MAINE
**PRESS RELEASE**
NATURALIZATION CEREMONY CELEBRATED
September 18, 2026
On September 18, 2026, U.S. District Judge Stacey D. Neumann commemorated Citizenship and Constitution Day with a special ceremony at the University of Southern Maine in Portland.
The Honorable Stacey D. Neumann presided and administered the oath of citizenship to forty-one new citizens from twenty-five different countries, including Angola, Bangladesh, Brazil, Burundi, Cambodia, Canada, Central African Republic, China, Columbia, Democratic Republic of Congo, Costa Rica, Djibouti, France, Greece, Hungary, India, Iraq, Kazakhstan, South Korea, Lithuania, Rwanda, South Sudan, Spain, the United Kingdom, and Vietnam.
A copy of Judge Neumann’s remarks are posted on the Court’s
website
.
items.content_html:
Friday, September 18, 2026

UNITED STATES DISTRICT COURT

Description automatically generated

DISTRICT OF MAINE

**PRESS RELEASE**

NATURALIZATION CEREMONY CELEBRATED

September 18, 2026

 

On September 18, 2026, U.S. District Judge Stacey D. Neumann commemorated Citizenship and Constitution Day with a special ceremony at the University of Southern Maine in Portland.

The Honorable Stacey D. Neumann presided and administered the oath of citizenship to forty-one new citizens from twenty-five different countries, including Angola, Bangladesh, Brazil, Burundi, Cambodia, Canada, Central African Republic, China, Columbia, Democratic Republic of Congo, Costa Rica, Djibouti, France, Greece, Hungary, India, Iraq, Kazakhstan, South Korea, Lithuania, Rwanda, South Sudan, Spain, the United Kingdom, and Vietnam.

A copy of Judge Neumann’s remarks are posted on the Court’s website.
